assumptions: Company A = Ramu fixed (debt 100, cash 40, EBITDA 85, market cap 1,000)
Company B has market cap 1,000; sliders set debt 0-800 step 10, cash 0-300 step 5, EBITDA 40-200 step 5; default 400/40/115 (Part 7 trap)
PBT = EBITDA - 12 D&A - 10% x debt + 10% x cash; PAT = PBT x 50/67 (Ramu own tax share 17 of 67) if PBT>0 else PBT; P/E = 1,000/PAT only if PAT>0
P/E bars cut at 100x with "(cut)" and the full value printed
Payout lab: equity 250, 10 cr shares, price 100; profit = ROE x 250; ROE stepper 5-40 step 5; payout slider 0-100 step 5
lab.independent_calculation_method: labtest.py: exact Fraction oracle written separately from page compute(); driven through Playwright (Chromium); compares window.labResults / payResults / pbResults and bar geometry

cases.detail: default, 4 presets (twin equals A exactly), 8 slider corners, PBT=0 break-even, PBT 0.5/1 P/E-cap cases, loss case, 300 random points
payout 0..100 step 5 x ROE 20,5,10,25,30,35,40; invariants kept/equity == ROE x retention; bars start at 0 and end at axis value; canonical 40/20 gives DPS 2, yield 2, retention 60, growth 12
25 (P/B 1, minus disabled) .. 300 (P/B 12, plus disabled), back to 100 = 4.0

invariants: payout bar widths = value x 2.68; EV lab ticks 0, m/2, m with bars from zero
no NaN/Infinity/undefined in chart, ledger or verdict
lab.axis_and_clipping: EV lab axis = nice(max bar), grows with data; P/E above 100 drawn at 100 with "(cut)" and full value in label; payout axis fixed 0-100; n/m P/E has no bar
